## AC-3

"Feels welcoming" and "easy for every customer to understand" are judgements, not something a test can measure.
`test_confirmation_names_show_and_seats` (`tests/test_booking.py:15`) passes, but it only checks that the text names
the show and the number of seats. It runs the same code without proving the criterion, so AC-3 is not verified, as
`AGENTS.md:8-9` asks. I left the story unchanged (`AGENTS.md:10`); the story's writer needs to restate AC-3 before it
can be tested.
